subject: general
question: The ratio of the speeds of a bus and a car is 7 ∶ 11. If the car covers a distance of 396 km in 6 hours, what is the speed of the bus in km/h?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Car speed** = 396 ÷ 6 = 66 km/h.

According to the **ratio** 7 : 11, the **car speed** is represented by 11 units.

11 units → 66 km/h ⇒ 1 unit = 6 km/h.

**Bus speed** (7 units) = 7 × 6 = 42 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 42 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Ratio** of speeds (Bus : Car) = 7 : 11

**Distance** covered by car = 396 km

**Time** taken by car = 6 hr

**Formula used:**

**Speed** = **Distance** ÷ **Time**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07e611de366a709bab7c0ae423e6b269f8a62bbd26752a497a31985d86e75cc8.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Speed of Car** = 396 ÷ 6

⇒ **Speed of Car** = 66 km/h

⇒ Let the **Speed of Bus** be 7x and **Speed of Car** be 11x.

⇒ 11x = 66

⇒ x = 66 ÷ 11 = 6

⇒ **Speed of Bus** = 7x = 7 × 6

⇒ **Speed of Bus** = 42 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 42 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Conversion of Speed Units

To convert speed from **km/h** to **m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert from **m/s** to **km/h**, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

**Average Speed** = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. For two equal distances at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy/(x+y).

Relative Speed

If two objects move in the **same direction**, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. If they move in **opposite directions**, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.</p
